title.rendered: Bose SoundLink Flex Portable Speaker (2nd Gen)

content.rendered:
Bose SoundLink Flex Portable Speaker (2nd Gen) – Premium Bluetooth Speaker with 12 Hour Battery & IP67 Water Resistance

The Bose SoundLink Flex Portable Speaker (2nd Gen) is engineered for powerful performance in a compact design. Built for music lovers who want premium sound on the go, this Bluetooth portable speaker delivers deep bass, clear vocals, and balanced audio wherever you travel. Whether you’re at home, outdoors, at the beach, or on a road trip, this wireless Bluetooth speaker combines durability, style, and advanced connectivity for an unmatched listening experience.

Designed with high-quality materials including aluminum, fabric, nylon, plastic, silicone, and steel, the Bose SoundLink Flex Portable Speaker (2nd Gen) offers a rugged yet elegant finish. Its IP67 water resistant speaker rating ensures protection against water and dust, making it ideal for outdoor adventures, pool parties, camping trips, and everyday use.

Powerful Sound Performance with Advanced Bluetooth Connectivity

Experience immersive audio powered by acoustic engineering. This portable Bluetooth speaker features optimized drivers that deliver crisp highs, detailed mids, and rich bass. With seamless wireless connectivity via Bluetooth, you can easily pair your smartphone, tablet, or laptop within seconds.

The integrated built-in microphone allows you to take calls hands-free, making this device more than just a music speaker. Whether you’re attending virtual meetings or answering calls on the go, the clarity remains exceptional.

Long Battery Life with Fast USB-C Charging

The offers up to 12 hours battery life on a single charge, ensuring uninterrupted entertainment throughout the day. With a 4 hours battery charge time, you can quickly power up using the modern USB C port charging interface. This efficient charging system ensures convenience and compatibility with most modern charging cables.

Audio cable included: No — designed primarily for wireless freedom, this focuses on cable-free convenience and seamless pairing.

Durable, Travel-Ready & Water Resistant IP67

Built to withstand tough conditions, this IP67 rated waterproof speaker is resistant to dust, splashes, rain, and accidental drops in water. The premium construction materials — aluminum body, woven fabric grille, and reinforced silicone components — provide enhanced durability without compromising style.

Its lightweight and compact structure makes it an excellent portable outdoor speaker for hiking, cycling, beach trips, and backyard gatherings. The durable nylon utility loop adds portability, allowing easy attachment to bags or hooks.

Why Choose?

  • Wireless Connectivity: Bluetooth
  • Microphones: Built-in Microphone for hands-free calls
  • Water Resistant: IP67 rating (dustproof & waterproof)
  • Battery Life: Up to 12 hours
  • Battery Charge Time: Approximately 4 hours
  • Charging Interface: USB C Port
  • Product Materials: Aluminum, Fabric, Nylon, Plastic, Silicone, Steel
  • Audio Cable Included: No
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel friendly design
  • Ideal for home, office, outdoor, travel, and gifting

Perfect Portable Bluetooth Speaker for Every Occasion

If you’re searching for the best long battery life, and waterproof protection, the stands out in performance and reliability. Its sleek design complements modern interiors, while the rugged exterior ensures durability outdoors.

This is suitable for daily entertainment, parties, travel, and corporate gifting. The balance of premium sound quality, sturdy materials, and wireless convenience makes it one of the most trusted choices in the category. Upgrade your music experience with the a powerful, stylish, and durable designed for every adventure.
